rules.statement: If a will is made by a testator and is shown to have been in his possession but not forthcoming at the time of death, it is presumed to have been destroyed with intent to revoke.
rules.supporting_quote: It is an accepted principle of the law that if a will is made by a testator, and is shown to have been in his possession and is not forth-coming at his death, it is presumed to have been destroyed animo revocandi.
